OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF TRANSPORTATION
WASHINGTON, D.C. 20590
Honorable Charles J. Orlebeke Deputy Under Secretary Department of Housing and Urban Development Washington, D.C. 20410
Dear Mr. Orlebeke:
The Department of Transportation has appreciated the opportunity to review the proposed language of the very comprehensive environmental statement related to Operation Breakthrough. Our constituent organizations have shared in our review and find the statement to be acceptable.
The unique opportunity which characterizes Cperation Breakthrough, in the total design of a housing environment, provides your department with the capacity to address environmental elements at the conceptual and each succeeding stage. Provisions for transportation, energy and power, waste disposal as well as improved housing itself should insure adherence to sound environmental balance in the Operation Breakthrough Program.
Having recently been appointed to this cosition, I would express my hope to work cooperatively with you and your colleagues at the Department of Housing and Urban Development.
Sincerely,
Herbert F. DeSimone
Assistant Secretary for
Environment and Urban Systems
